title: Abusing the Internet of Medical Things: Evaluating Threat Models and Forensic Readiness for Multi-Vector Attacks on Connected Healthcare Devices
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of threat modeling and digital forensics for medical devices in the context of technology-facilitated abuse.
